{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:", sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check the value counts for key columns
print("\nChannel value counts:\\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment value counts:\\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print("\nStatus value counts:\\n", sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check the revenue column type and sample values
print("\nRevenue dtype:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("\nSample revenue values:\\n", sales_df['revenue'].head(10))"}
